353:t_2:13.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「What do you mean, $$フェルト$$?」

353:t_2:14.en:
$$フェルト$$
「I checked $$万丈$$'s war data for $$蒼の地球$$. Supreme Commander $$ストラウス$$ has won every battle they've fought in.」

353:t_2:15.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「So they really are a brilliant commander...」

353:t_2:16.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「And someone like that pulled back so easily today.」

353:t_2:17.en:
$$フェルト$$
「They may have had something in mind.」

353:t_2:18.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「What do you think, $$スメラギ$$?」

353:t_2:21.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「...Sorry. I was thinking about the EVAs...」

353:t_2:22.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「We're seeing people we thought we'd never see again. It really hits you.」

353:t_2:23.en:
$$スメラギ$$
(I hear that when the red-sea world transferred, $$サードインパクト$$ brought it to the brink of destruction...)

353:t_2:24.en:
$$スメラギ$$
(At its center was EVA Unit-01, piloted by $$シンジ$$...)

353:t_2:25.en:
$$スメラギ$$
(I can't believe the EVAs coming to this world again is a coincidence...)

353:t_2:26.en:
$$スメラギ$$
(EVA... Its existence could determine this world's fate... Yet no one knows its true nature...)

353:t_2:30.en: ～$$プトレマイオス２改$$ Briefing Room～

353:t_2:31.en:
$$カヲル$$
「...The data the people on this ship gave us has helped us understand the situation on this Earth.」

353:t_2:34.en:
$$カヲル$$
「Pulling out the spear during the battle in $$セントラルドグマ$$ caused a $$時空震動$$...」

353:t_2:36.en:
$$カヲル$$
「I don't really know, either. But I have some idea.」

353:t_2:37.en:
$$カヲル$$
「It was probably the result of the world rejecting us.」

353:t_2:39.en:
$$カヲル$$
「It's an act that destroys the natural order. Of course it carries those risks.」

353:t_2:40.en:
$$アスカ$$
「You keep acting like you know everything... Who are you?」

353:t_2:41.en:
$$カヲル$$
「I'm $$渚カヲル$$... $$シンジ$$'s friend and Unit-13's pilot.」

353:t_2:42.en:
$$カヲル$$
「It's nice to meet you, $$式波・アスカ・ラングレー$$, $$真希波・マリ・イラストリアス$$.」

353:t_2:43.en:
$$マリ$$
「Well, that's a surprise. You even know our names.」

353:t_2:44.en:
$$アスカ$$
「So you saw them in $$ＮＥＲＶ$$'s records.」

353:t_2:45.en:
$$カヲル$$
「I'll leave that to your imagination.」

353:t_2:46.en:
$$アスカ$$
「You're way too familiar. You just went ahead and took charge here.」

353:t_2:47.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Stop it, $$アスカ$$... $$カヲル$$ is...」

353:t_2:48.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Do you get it, Brat $$シンジ$$?! Our $$ヴィレ$$ exists to defeat your $$ＮＥＲＶ$$!」

353:t_2:49.en:
$$アスカ$$
「This is all because you nearly caused $$サードインパクト$$ fourteen years ago!」

353:t_2:50.en:
$$シンジ$$
「...I... only wanted to save $$綾波$$...」

353:t_2:51.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Do you know what happened to most of the world as a result...?!」

353:t_2:53.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Sure... You may not have meant to do it, but where are the survivors supposed to take their anger?!」

353:t_2:54.en:
$$マリ$$
「...I think taking it out on Puppy is misplaced too, nya~.」

353:t_2:56.en:
$$シンジ$$
(I... did all that... and in the end... I couldn't save $$綾波$$...)

353:t_2:58.en:
$$シンジ$$
(She looks just like $$綾波$$, but she isn't $$綾波$$... But I...)

353:t_2:59.en:
$$カヲル$$
「Lift your head, $$シンジ$$. You were supposed to have stopped hanging your head.」

353:t_2:61.en:
$$カヲル$$
「We decided to restore the world, didn't we?」

353:t_2:62.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Are you saying it's fine if humanity dies out for that?!」

353:t_2:63.en:
$$カヲル$$
「From your perspective, I suppose it would seem that way.」

353:t_2:64.en:
$$アスカ$$
「There you go, acting like you're the only one who understands...!」

353:t_2:65.en:
$$マリ$$
「All right, all right! That's enough, Princess!」

353:t_2:66.en:
$$マリ$$
「We got thrown here when one spear was pulled out of $$リリス$$, but we should've stopped the world from collapsing...」

353:t_2:67.en:
$$マリ$$
「Now it's a question of what we do, including whether we can get home.」

353:t_2:72.en:
$$カヲル$$
「Fortunately, we've made contact with people $$シンジ$$ and you two know.」

353:t_2:73.en:
$$カヲル$$
「And it seems a powerful organization in this world sees the EVAs as enemies.」

353:t_2:74.en:
$$マリ$$
「Well... After seeing $$サードインパクト$$, even if it didn't finish, you can't blame them.」

353:t_2:75.en:
$$カヲル$$
「Returning to our world comes first, but I think staying with $c is best until things settle down.」

353:t_2:76.en:
$$カヲル$$
「Of course, we'll have a temporary truce in the meantime...」

353:t_2:78.en:
$$カヲル$$
「What do you want to do, $$シンジ$$?」

353:t_2:80.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I'd rather you decided, $$カヲル$$.」

353:t_2:81.en:
$$カヲル$$
「I'll take that as reluctant agreement with my proposal.」

353:t_2:82.en:
$$アスカ$$
「...Brat $$シンジ$$... You can't even decide how to live your own life.」

353:t_2:83.en:
$$シンジ$$
「...What do you expect me to do in a situation like this...?」

353:t_2:84.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Besides, if I decide for myself and then get told the world was destroyed because of it...」

353:t_2:86.en:
$$カヲル$$
「What will you two do? Leave and survive on your own?」

353:t_2:87.en:
$$マリ$$
「Of course not...! I know how nice it is in this unit.」

353:t_2:88.en:
$$マリ$$
「Come on, Princess... Stop being stubborn. Shall we shake hands on the truce?」

353:t_2:90.en:
$$マリ$$
「...The Princess is in a bad mood, but we don't have any other choice...」

353:t_2:92.en:
$$マリ$$
「I'll go with your proposal. You, me, her, him, and that girl: let's all five survive in this world full of fighting.」

353:t_2:93.en:
$$カヲル$$
「All right. Then let's tell this unit's commanders our decision.」

353:t_2:94.en:
$$マリ$$
「Well, Princess... Never mind that guy for now. How about shaking hands with Puppy?」
